column3: NKJV includes “like snow,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
Close to the Greek; “listen to Him” is rendered “Hear Him!”
Close to the Greek; “set at naught” is rendered “treated with contempt.”
NKJV has “He came … He saw,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “they came … they saw.”
NKJV has “He asked the scribes,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “He asked them.”
Close to the Greek; “is withering away” is rendered “becomes rigid.”
NKJV has “If you can believe,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “‘If you can!’ All things are possible ….”
NKJV includes “with tears” and “Lord,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “cried out and said, ‘I believe; help my unbelief!’”
NKJV includes “and fasting,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has only “by prayer.”
